description.html: With a volume of 19 liters and dimensions of 34x20x28 cm, this terrarium includes a handmade 3D background. The background imitates natural relief, such as rock or bark, and adds depth to the space so animals can climb, hide and feel more secure.

With a floor area of 34x20 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. Mesh covers on the ventilation openings let air through but not food or the small inhabitants of the terrarium.

Every terrarium we make is handmade, so you can choose the dimensions, film color, ventilation type and 3D background style. We also build fully custom models to your needs, so contact us for a consultation. Delivery throughout Serbia.
